invalid_guidance: This change is unavailable because its instructions are incomplete.
refresh_failed: Couldn't get the latest settings ({error}). What's shown may be out of date.
unsupported_version: These settings come from a newer version of Persona. They're shown here but can't be changed until Persona is updated.
unsupported_kind: This setting needs a newer version of Persona to show or change.
unsupported_definition: This setting can't be shown here because its description isn't valid.
invalid_value: Its saved value isn't valid here, so it can't be shown. Use the default to fix it.
error_unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the save: the request failed or the answer couldn't be read, so it may or may not have been saved. Reload to check; anything you typed is kept.
error_invalid_document: The settings came back in a form this version of Persona can't read.
error_configuration_bad_request: That request couldn't be read, so nothing was saved.
error_configuration_version: This version of Persona can't save these settings.
error_configuration_too_large: These settings are too large to save. Shorten them and try again.
error_configuration_invalid: That change isn't valid, so nothing was saved.
error_configuration_conflict: These settings changed somewhere else, so nothing was saved. Reload to see the latest; anything you typed is kept.
error_configuration_forbidden: You don't have permission to change this.
error_configuration_not_found: These settings aren't available any more.
error_configuration_unavailable: Couldn't reach these settings, so a save may or may not have happened. Reload before trying again; anything you typed is kept.
error_duplicate: The same choice is listed twice.
error_minimum: Enter a number that isn't below the minimum.
error_maximum: Enter a number that isn't above the maximum.
error_range: Enter a number in the allowed range.
error_unknown: These settings no longer include that field. Reload to see the latest.
error_unsupported: This setting can't be changed in this version of Persona.
